kata.name: Factory-method dispatch agreement - a new product kind whose arm still falls through to the default, caught by the accepted equation on an unsampled kind
kata.series_report: docs/ref/pattern-kata-dispositions.md Factory Method row (disposed; construction dispatch); fixtures/katas/factory-method/README.md (pre-registered); beads catherine-r5k.2
kata.series_verdict: pre-registered: the dispatch agreement equation emits an executed violation on the unsampled kind yaml (row 3); the sampled scripted test does not cover it, one unique element, scoped to exhaustive enumeration (coverage-only)

expected.detail: kind yaml was added to the inventory (creator(yaml) = create_yaml) but its arm still resolves through handler(r_yaml) = create_default; the accepted equation route;handler = creator emits an executed violation on the yaml row. The baseline sample is {json, text}

commands: python3 prototype/factory_method_baseline.py --assert  # exit 0: baseline sample is {json, text}; no detection on yaml
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/factory-method/dispatch.ct.json --json  # exit 0, findings []
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/factory-method/fault-silent-default.ct.json --json  # exit 3, 1 violation

comparison.conventional_baseline: the scripted factory test over the pre-registered sample {json, text}: it asserts the returned concrete creator for each sampled kind only. yaml is unsampled, so the fall-through to create_default is invisible to it.

baseline.artifact: prototype/factory_method_baseline.py sha256:62553030b06c98d87d43bed081b1d857b2d41fb9d243d63bf17ee93e0cbf3848 (scripted sampled factory dispatch test; always executed before the probe arm)

discrepancies: Scope: the unique element is a sampling gap. A baseline that enumerated every declared kind would catch F1 (its frozen expectation is create_yaml); the kernel's contribution is exhaustive evaluation of the declared relation plus route totality, not a new engine capability.
procedure: 1. The law (route;handler = creator, plus route totality) and the fault matrix were committed in fixtures/katas/factory-method/README.md and faults.json before this run.
2. The baseline arm (sha256 above) executed first over the frozen sample {json, text}; it recorded no detection for the unsampled yaml fault.
3. The probe arm ran `catherine check --json` on the clean four-kind table (zero findings) and on the silent-default variant (one violation).
4. The violation's row (3) resolves to the pre-registered element kind:yaml over the declared alphabetical ProductKind rows; unique = {kind:yaml} - {}.
5. Verdict: non-empty unique with an executed baseline arm -> survived, scoped coverage-only: a conventional test that enumerated every declared kind reaches parity.
